title: American Airlines tops US complaints
summary: In May 2026 it drew the most DOT complaints of any US carrier (1,181: 302 flight problems, 288 refunds, 149 baggage).
opportunity: An assistant that auto-files disruption and refund claims for the traveler.

title: Summer refund vs. credit confusion
summary: Travelers hit long service-counter queues, trouble getting hotel vouchers, and confusion over refunds versus future credits.
opportunity: A claim tracker that chases carriers/OTAs and shows where a refund is stuck.

title: Japan cost spike
summary: Departure tax tripled to ¥3,000 (Jul 1), single-entry visa ¥3,000→¥15,000, tax-free shopping moves to airport refunds Nov 1.
opportunity: A "true cost of travel" calculator baking taxes/levies into the booking price.

title: Global fee wave
summary: US $750 non-refundable premium visa-interview fast-track; Edinburgh tourist tax from Jul 24; ETIAS launching Q4.
opportunity: A live entry-rule and fee monitor alerting travelers to changes on their route.

title: Booking.com login & payment failures
summary: Jul 14–27: "Sign in failed" errors, payments going through with no booking shown, Extranet messages not loading.

title: Reservation mismatches
summary: Users report paid bookings the system says don't exist, and listings showing the wrong hotel.
opportunity: A reservation-integrity monitor that flags silent changes.

title: Majorca strikes + anti-tourism protests
summary: From Jul 26: Swissport airport walkouts (also Aug 1/4/8, 7am–12pm & 7–10pm) plus an anti-tourism demonstration.
opportunity: A predictive disruption calendar scoring an itinerary's strike/protest risk.

title: UK + Italy airport disruption
summary: Heathrow/Gatwick/Manchester saw one of summer's heaviest cancellation days on Jul 2; Italy ran national aviation strikes Jul 5.
opportunity: A proactive rebooking concierge that pre-stages alternatives.
